newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares lose 1.33 pct in correction.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares lose 1.33 pct in correction.

text.p: Istanbul shares lost an average 1.33 percent on Wednesday in profit-taking that followed the recent sharp gains fuelled by political optimism, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed 27 points, or 1.33 percent lower at 2,009, bringing the fall to 1.7 percent since Monday's all-time high close of 2,043. The index brushed a low of 1,972 in the afternoon when sales accelerated.
Daily trade volume dropped to 24.06 trillion lira ($156.3 million) from Tuesday's 28.26 trillion ($183.8 million).
"The market faces a correction after the recent strong rally. But I expect the uptrend to resume in coming days," said Hasan Soydan from garanti Securities.
The market index had soared 30.5 percent and hit 10 records to Monday's all-time high close of 2,043 amid new government hopes after the June 18 resignation of the former Islamist-led coalition.
The new right-left coalition government won a key confidence vote in parliament on Saturday, ending driving expectations in the stock market.
